primary_ties: Determinate prediction, zero correct decisions; no half credit or fitted epsilon
pairwise_orientation: Both exact AB/BA choices must agree; disagreement is ORDER_CONFLICT and incomplete

attrition.complete_target: Every registered primary pair in stratum has LEFT, RIGHT or TIE; missing, abstention and order conflict are incomplete

sensitivity.quantity: all-planned candidate minus historical point accuracy
sensitivity.guard: Every nonempty leaveout must satisfy expert +0.05 or lay -0.03; any empty/uncomputed leaveout fails closed

coverage_guard: Candidate directional pair coverage at least historical in every claimed stratum, with all planned ballot and pair denominators retained
source_unknown_guard: Any nonbinary/missing released Preference keeps claim guards closed
label_gate: Explicit conditional postprediction release, pinned own true outer 0/3 and invocation/job binding for both endpoints, all 10340 original terminal dispositions replay verified; qualified recovery is not strict admission
decoder: Only exact positional Preference Excerpt1/Excerpt2; other or missing values preserved UNKNOWN/MISSING without aliases; source prose and rationale values skipped
readiness_bounds: Descriptive scoring sensitivity, not statistical confidence intervals or strict-context pair intervals
